description: NaCoO₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.38 Å) and three longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Co is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing CoO₆ octahedra. All Co-O bond lengths are 2.05 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Co atoms to form edge-sharing ONa₃Co₃ octahedra.
